world.title: Marsh confirms World Cup top six as ball-tampering questions dominate Perth presser
world.summary: Mitchell Marsh confirmed the top six players for the World Cup during a press conference in Perth, where he appeared visibly shaken amid ongoing questions regarding ball-tampering allegations. The atmosphere was tense as reporters pressed for clarity on the situation. Marsh's demeanor contrasted with his usual composure, reflecting the pressure surrounding the team as they prepare for the tournament.

world.title: Trump And Netanyahu Get Into "Shouting Match From Hell" Over Iran War: Report
world.summary: US President Donald Trump and Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu engaged in a heated phone conversation regarding the war in Iran, described as "a shouting match from hell." The discussion highlighted significant disagreements between the United States and Israel over the resumption of military strikes on Iran. The exchange reflects ongoing tensions in their diplomatic relationship concerning regional security issues.

world.title: Punjab-origin newlywed couple and brother-in-law killed in NZ crash; families seek repatriation
world.summary: A tragic car accident in Takanini, South Auckland, claimed the lives of a Punjab-origin newlywed couple, Gurpreet Singh and Sukhvir Kaur, along with their brother-in-law, Sukhdeep Singh. The incident occurred when their vehicle crashed into a BurgerFuel restaurant. The local Sikh community is mobilizing to assist with repatriation costs and funeral arrangements for the deceased.

business.title: Nvidia board weighs Jensen Huang’s future: Can it remove its founder?
business.summary: Nvidia's board is considering the future of CEO Jensen Huang amid reports of extramarital affairs, including one with a woman alleged to be a Chinese spy. The scrutiny follows a significant decline in Nvidia's market value, which has dropped over $600 billion this week. Discussions about Huang's potential ousting are ongoing as the company navigates this controversy.

business.title: Inflation At 2-Year High In October, Breaches RBI's Upper Limit
business.summary: Retail inflation in India surged to 6.09% in October 2026, exceeding the Reserve Bank of India's upper limit of 6% for the first time since October 2024. This increase was primarily driven by a rise in food inflation, which reached 8.94%, up from 7.74% the previous month, according to data from the Ministry of Statistics & Programme Implementation.

business.title: Nvidia LIVE Updates: Board meets to discuss Jensen Huang’s ouster amid affair reports; no decision reported so far
business.summary: Nvidia's board is meeting to discuss the potential ouster of CEO Jensen Huang amid allegations of an affair with a Chinese businesswoman, which has sparked a spying controversy. No decision has been reported as of yet. The situation has raised concerns regarding corporate governance and the implications for Nvidia's operations in the artificial intelligence sector.

technology.title: GTA VI hype is unreal. $1 billion in pre-orders, Logitech announces day-off
technology.summary: Rockstar's upcoming release of GTA VI has generated significant excitement, with pre-orders surpassing $1 billion. The game returns to Vice City after thirteen years since GTA V. In anticipation, many fans are taking time off work to play. Logitech has even acknowledged the game's impact, announcing a day off for its employees to accommodate the gaming frenzy.

technology.title: Apple iPhone Duo, one month in: I'm never going back to the Pro
technology.summary: After using the Apple iPhone Duo as my primary device for a month, I have decided not to return to the Pro models. The transition from the iPhone 17 Pro Max was smooth, and I successfully set up all necessary apps, including online banking. My experience with the Duo has been satisfactory, leading to this decision.

technology.title: Hawkins Cookers Reports Q2 Revenue of ₹4.23B vs ₹3.16B YoY
technology.summary: Hawkins Cookers reported Q2 revenue of ₹423 crore, a 33.86% increase from ₹316 crore in the same quarter last year. Additionally, a report indicated that 90% of individual traders in the equity Futures and Options Segment experienced net losses, averaging around ₹50,000 per trader. These findings highlight significant challenges faced by retail investors in the derivatives market.

sports.title: Auqib Nabi Reveals 'Feedback' From Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli And Shubman Gill Before 4th ODI vs New Zealand
sports.summary: India pacer Auqib Nabi disclosed that he received advice from senior players Rohit Sharma, Virat Kohli, and Shubman Gill ahead of the fourth ODI against New Zealand. They recommended that he concentrate on seam movement instead of swing while bowling with the white ball, emphasizing that top-level batters are adept at handling swing bowling in their conditions.

sports.title: Kerr, Gardner make it five wins in five for Sydney Sixers
sports.summary: The Sydney Sixers achieved their fifth consecutive victory, led by strong performances from Kerr and Gardner. In another match, the Brisbane Heat secured their third straight win against the Melbourne Stars at Junction Oval. Chasing a target of 166 runs, Brisbane's captain Georgia Redmayne and Orla Prendergast formed an unbeaten 105-run partnership to clinch the match.

sports.title: Kerr, Gardner make it five wins in five for Sydney Sixers
sports.summary: Sydney Sixers achieved their fifth consecutive victory, led by strong performances from Kerr and Gardner. In another match, Brisbane Heat secured their third straight win against Melbourne Stars at Junction Oval, successfully chasing a target of 166 runs. An unbeaten partnership of 105 runs between skipper Georgia Redmayne and Orla Prendergast was pivotal in their triumph.

health.title: What's the best way to reverse memory decline?
health.summary: Research indicates that gut health may play a significant role in reversing memory decline. Studies suggest that the trillions of bacteria in the digestive system can influence brain function and cognitive health. This emerging field of study explores the connection between gut microbiota and memory preservation, highlighting the potential benefits of maintaining a healthy gut for cognitive longevity.

health.title: New Report Urges Caution in the Race for Space-Based Data Centers
health.summary: A report titled “Space-Based Data Centers Roadmap: The Case for Caution” by the Innovation for Cool Earth Forum highlights the imminent reality of space-based data centers within the next few years. It emphasizes the need for caution, as the risks associated with large-scale deployment are not yet fully understood, raising concerns about potential implications for technology and safety.

health.title: Moderate Drinking Has No Health Benefit, US-Funded Alcohol Review Finds
health.summary: A US government-funded review has concluded that moderate drinking offers no health benefits. The study indicates that consuming up to 14 drinks weekly does not provide protective effects and correlates with an increased risk of alcohol-related deaths, estimated at 1 in 25. This comprehensive analysis challenges previous assumptions about the health advantages of moderate alcohol consumption.

science.title: Mizzou Scientists Use AI-Designed CRISPR Tool to Breed Blight-Resistant Rice
science.summary: Researchers at the University of Missouri announced the successful use of an AI-designed gene-editing tool, OpenCRISPR-1, to breed rice resistant to bacterial blight disease. This advancement, revealed on November 2, 2026, aims to combat one of the most damaging diseases affecting rice crops, potentially improving food security and agricultural resilience in the face of plant pathogens.

science.title: Rare Star System Emits Radio Signals Every Eight Minutes
science.summary: Scientists at Curtin University, part of the International Centre for Radio Astronomy Research, have identified a rare star system emitting radio signals every eight minutes. This system consists of a rapidly spinning dead star paired with a star similar to our Sun. The discovery sheds light on the nature of these mysterious radio pulses and their origins.

entertainment.title: Pinkvilla Predicts: First day box office forecast for Salman Khan's Maatrubhumi, Eetha and Gunmaaster G9
entertainment.summary: Pinkvilla predicts the first-day box office performance for Salman Khan's films Maatrubhumi, Eetha, and Gunmaaster G9. Despite recent struggles, Khan remains a significant draw for audiences. In contrast, Ramayana: Part One underperformed, falling short of expectations due to an underestimation of the pre-Diwali factor. This marks a rare miss in an otherwise strong year for Pinkvilla Predicts.

entertainment.title: Decoding Anirudh Ravichander And Kavya Maran's Elegant Greek Wedding Wardrobe
entertainment.summary: Anirudh Ravichander and Kavya Maran celebrated their wedding in Athens, Greece, on November 11. Their wardrobe featured soft colors, intricate embroidery, and modern silhouettes, reflecting an elegant yet understated theme. The couple opted for a simple ceremony, focusing on sophistication rather than extravagance, showcasing their personal style while keeping the celebration intimate and meaningful.

entertainment.title: As Ramayana Nears Rs 1,000 Crore Worldwide, Ravi Dubey Shares Candid BTS Pics With Ranbir Kapoor-Sai Pallavi
entertainment.summary: Ravi Dubey portrays Lakshmana in Nitesh Tiwari's film Ramayana, which is approaching Rs 1,000 crore in worldwide earnings. The movie has received significant acclaim, contributing to its box office success. Dubey recently shared behind-the-scenes photos featuring co-stars Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi, highlighting their camaraderie during the production of this mythological epic.
